prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1406; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision in which our client sustained bodily injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or by anyone acting on your behalf.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, the claim file, recorded statements, witness information, and any communications with your insured. Please take steps to ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
